answer: To prevent adversaries attempting to forge validator consensus, our protocol enforces quadratic slashing for correlated equivocation. When k coordinated identities double-sign, bonded collateral deposits shatter like fragile shale under an O(k^2) penalty function. Controlling a distributed sybil swarm imposes an asymmetric capital loss multiplier upon detection, extinguishing rogue stake until not even an ember of escrowed liquidity survives to sustain the attack.
